name: Death Burst
description: When the creature is reduced to 0 hit points, the creature crumbles, and the creature returns to the afterlife in a burst of ghostly white flame. Each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or take 3 (1d6) radiant damage.
